claims: Obtain a repeat complete blood count to confirm and trend the anemia (hemoglobin 7.7 g/dL, hematocrit 27.6%) and leukopenia (WBC 2.4 K/uL).
Monitor for signs of anemia-related end-organ hypoperfusion and check for occult bleeding, given hemoglobin 7.7 g/dL and hematocrit 27.6%.
Assess and manage alcohol withdrawal with symptom-triggered CIWA monitoring, given history of ETOH use and fluctuating tremor/CIWA scores.
Continue thiamine supplementation for alcohol-use-related nutritional risk.
Monitor and replete electrolytes, including potassium 3.4 mEq/L, magnesium 1.8 mg/dL, and phosphate 2.6 mg/dL.
Monitor blood glucose and manage hyperglycemia, given fingerstick glucose values of 208 and 294 mg/dL.
Assess and manage the mildly elevated anion gap metabolic profile (anion gap 11 mEq/L, bicarbonate 21 mEq/L).
Maintain fall precautions and delirium monitoring, given fluctuating mental status and fall-risk factors.
Continue maintenance intravenous fluids (D5NS at 5 mL/hour).
